'; C00002 -> 'C00002	KEGG Compound	Ch:HMDB0000538,Wd:Q80863,Cs:5742

'. Structure: base = struct('keggId',NaN,'hmdb',NaN,'wikidata',NaN,'cheBIId',NaN,'chemspider',NaN,'pubChemId',NaN) plus *_source NaN, inchiString NaN, charge NaN; s.VMH_glc_D.keggId = 'C00031'; s.VMH_atp.keggId = 'C00002', hmdb = 'HMDB9999999', hmdb_source = 'old'; [o, added, mism] = parseBridgeDb(s) -> added = {VMH_glc_D hmdb HMDB0000122; VMH_glc_D wikidata Q37525}, mism = '' ; after s.VMH_atp.fullName = 'ATP': added also VMH_atp wikidata Q80863 and chemspider 5742, mism lists the hmdb mismatch (3 times, because keggId is queried with codes Ck, Kd, Kl and the stand-in answers all three). The answer format (<id> TAB <data source name> TAB comma-separated code:id) is the code's assumption (it parses tokens 3..end after whitespace split). Without a stand-in, every query runs curl against webservice.bridgedb.org (internet), which is why the row was flagged external-program; with the stand-in a full offline test (needsUnix) is possible once fixed. Also: line 43 tests isfield(..., VMHId) with the cell VMHId instead of 'VMHId', so VMHId(:,2) is always the field name - VMHId is never used afterwards (no effect, not recorded). The try without catch (line 92) violates constitution VII-C in src (not ours to fix). Caller parseDBCollection calls it for every structure (every call with ChEBI in an answer reaches the defect).
